about_the_game:
You are beneath her gaze. All the time.

This is a one route/linear/Kinect Visual Novel (with few choices) about a woman who is...kinda tall. Slow Burn Story.

Discover all the mysteries about her. Dive into madness. Control your urges.

Remember, It's just a Ecchi Visual Novel.

About a Quiet Big Lady.

Features

- It's linear, but you do have choices! Continue the main story or discover many lose scenarios and unlock extra content along the way.

- An extra IsaPet game with mini-games included!
- Unique and original art style - many illustrations and 2D animations are drawn by hand!
- A minimalist UI coupled with an aesthetically-pleasing 4:3 resolution.
- Drawn by Hand.
- Many Illustrations and 2d Animations.
- Really Atmospheric.
- Dark Comedy, Light Drama.
- You can say that you downloaded because of the plot.

content_descriptors.notes: It contains Violency, nudity, hipersexualization of body parts.
